## The claim

A reference k-mer bait sampled at a fixed stride recovers the reads that carry a known alternate allele inside the baited region.

**Prediction if true.** For at least 100 heterozygous PASS single-nucleotide alleles drawn by script from the delivered callset inside target-gene intervals, at least 90% of the reads the existing 500-probe strike finds carrying the alternate 31-mer are also present in the bait sweep's survivor set, at stride 16.

**What would refute it.** Recall below 0.90, in which case the stride is lowered and the pass repeated before any allele discovered by it is interpreted; a recall this low would mean the survivor set is not a superset of the region's variant-carrying reads and every downstream absence would be uninterpretable.

## Weighing

```
prior 0.50  (log-odds +0.000)
  +1.000  supports 0.50 — Of 4,451 reads the 500-probe strike found carrying a witness alternate 31-mer, 4,029 are present in the bait sweep's survivor set: recall 0.9052, just over the 0.90 line.   -> 0.731
  +0.000  neutral 0.30 — The per-probe bootstrap interval on that recall is [0.815, 0.974] and only 59% of replicates clear 0.90, so the measurement cannot distinguish 0.85 from 0.95.   -> 0.731
  +0.800  supports 0.40 — Post-hoc: 184 of 195 probes have read counts consistent with a single-copy allele and recall 0.9832 there; the 11 probes found in more reads than one locus can supply recall 0.5312 and carry most of the loss.   -> 0.858
suggested confidence 0.86 (2 supporting, 0 refuting, 1 neutral)
```

The weighing is a transparent heuristic for triage, not a calibrated posterior: the strengths are human judgments, and rows drawn from the same underlying data are not independent the way the sum treats them.

**The committed confidence differs from the suggestion by -0.21.** The reasoning below is why.

## History

| Rev | Status | Confidence | Reasoning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | proposed | — | — |
| 2 | supported | 0.65 | Supported on the pre-registered statistic and not comfortably. The point estimate is 0.9052 against a 0.90 line — 24 more lost reads would have refuted it — and the per-probe bootstrap interval [0.815, 0.974] contains values well below the threshold, with only 59% of replicates clearing it. The heuristic's 0.86 is overridden down to 0.65 for that reason: the correlated unit is the probe, there are 195 of them, and the measurement cannot separate 0.85 from 0.95. What raises it above the bootstrap's own 0.59 is the post-hoc split: 184 probes with single-copy read counts recall 0.9832, while the 11 probes found in more reads than one locus can supply recall 0.5312 and carry most of the loss — which points at the witness design rather than the stride, since the witness filter checked each allele's REFERENCE k-mer for uniqueness while the strike searches for its ALTERNATE. That gap is recorded for the next run; it is not a licence to restate the number. |
